reddit.title: Exciting Updates in Provincia: Multilingual Support and Improved Placement Feedback
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the user interface in Provincia! Our build UI now supports ten languages, ensuring a more inclusive experience for all players. Additionally, we've enhanced placement feedback, making it clearer when actions fail. No more guessing why a placement didn't work! Plus, our day/night transitions are smoother than ever, preventing any hitches in gameplay. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ten-locales-clearer-placement?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ten-locales-clearer-placement
